Interactive D3 violin plot

pv_violin.Rd

Mirrored kernel density curves, one violin per group on a shared value axis — the boxplot's five numbers replaced by the distribution's whole shape, so bimodality and skew stay visible. Each violin reaches 85% of its band at its own mode, so all the shapes read equally wide and only their outline differs. Hovering a violin dims the others and reads out the group's size, median, and quartiles.

Usage

pv_violin(
  data,
  value,
  group,
  box = TRUE,
  points = FALSE,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  mode = "auto",
  duration = 600,
  source = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  elementId = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

value

Name of the numeric column whose distribution is drawn. Rows with a missing value or group are dropped with a warning.

group

Name of the grouping column (one violin per level, max 8; every level needs at least 2 non-missing values for a density).

box

Overlay a slim Tukey box-and-whisker inside each violin? TRUE always draws it, FALSE never does; "auto" draws it — same as TRUE today, but reserved for a future data-driven rule. The box marks the quartiles and median so the shapes stay anchored to exact numbers.

points

Also show the raw values as jittered points inside each violin? The dots stay within the silhouette — each one's sideways room is the violin's width at its own value — so the cloud traces the same shape the outline does. TRUE always draws them (groups with more than 400 values are thinned to a fixed-seed sample of 400, exactly like pv_boxplot()), FALSE (the default) never does, and "auto" draws them only while every group holds at most 200 values — few enough that the dots inside the narrow shape still read individually.

xlab, ylab

Axis titles. NULL (the default) uses the group column name for x and the value column name for y; NA or "" suppresses the title; any other string replaces it.

title, subtitle

Optional chart heading text.

mode

"auto" (default: follow the viewer's light/dark setting), "light", or "dark".

duration

Entrance transition length in ms.

source

Optional source/credit line, shown small and grey at the bottom left — e.g. "Source: Bundesamt für Statistik".

width, height, elementId

Standard htmlwidgets sizing arguments.

Value

An htmlwidget.

Examples

pv_violin(pv_fiscal, value = "resource_per_capita", group = "year",
          title = "Municipal tax resources by year")
